During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] forces, backed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], '''massacred''' the [[Schenor]] population on a [[Schenor research station|research station]]. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] operatives attempted to intervene, but were too late to save the colonists, save for a single juvenile known as [[A'kazz]]. They transported him to the Schenor [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Rhamsis Callo]], when his [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathic]] testimony convinced his [[nest-guildmaster]], [[B'karitz]], to break the [[Schenor/Imperial treaty]].<ref name="Silent" />
